in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is devoted to the gods.

in_marathi.name: Devan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘deva’ meaning god or heavenly being. In Hindu mythology, the Devas are divine beings or gods, responsible for various natural phenomena and aspects of the universe. Devan is a powerful and spiritual name, evoking a sense of reverence and connection to the divine.
